_style.name_order: Full names in Western order (Akemi Iwashita). Characters address each other by surname as in the Japanese.
_style.honorifics: Dropped (-san, -kun, -senpai). Use the plain surname; keep 'senpai' only where the senior/junior relation is the point of the line. DECISION PENDING USER CONFIRMATION.
